# FG-GIT-0010

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `reserved_ref_namespace_is_rejected_even_for_admins` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この名前の ref には push できません（GitStation が管理する領域です）。
- en: This ref cannot be pushed: it is in a namespace managed by GitStation.
- id: Ref ini tidak dapat di-push: berada di namespace yang dikelola GitStation.

## 原因 (cause)

A push targeted a ref outside refs/heads/ and refs/tags/ (for example refs/merge-requests/*, refs/replace/*, refs/meta/*). Those namespaces are written only by forge; a client-pushed replace ref could make a reviewed commit show other content.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `action`. The rejected ref name is in the push command list (log only).

## 対処 (fix)

Push branches under refs/heads/ and tags under refs/tags/ only.
